## What's new in 0.5.2
- **A steadier route map.** Moving the pointer across the plots now only moves the dot on the map. The map no longer zooms or changes size as you hover in and out, and it stays framed on the whole route when you pick a rep. You can still pan and zoom it yourself. - **Steadier plots.** The readout under the plots keeps the same height whether or not you are hovering, so nothing around it shifts.

## What's new in 0.5.1
- **Activity details get the whole window.** Click **Show details** in the inspector, double-click a completed workout, or choose **Show Details** from its menu. The workout fills the window: the plots on the left, the reps and route on the right. **‹ Calendar** at the top left (or Esc, or ⌘[) takes you back with the workout still selected. - **A simpler calendar.** Clicking a completed workout now just selects it, so you can browse the week without the details opening each time. The drawer and its resize handle are gone.

## What's new in 0.5.0
- **See how a workout went.** Click a completed workout to open its details under the week. Power (or pace) is drawn over the planned target, with heart rate below on the same time line. Optional lanes show cadence, W′ balance and altitude. Move the pointer across the plot to read any moment. - **Every rep at a glance.** The interval table lists each recorded rep with its average power or pace, heart rate and how long heart rate took to reach zone 4, checked against the plan. Click a rep to highlight it on the plot and the route map. - **Compare reps.** Put two reps side by side from their own start, to see how much earlier heart rate climbed as the session went on. - **Room to look.** Drag the handle to resize the details, collapse the inspector with › to give them more width, and switch to the month view to see the activity's week pinned above them. Gaps, pauses and missing heart rate are shown as they are, never filled in.

## What's new in 0.4.0
- **A full workout builder.** Click **Open in builder** next to a planned workout's steps to edit it in its own window. Drag blocks from the palette onto the workout (or click one to add it), drag a step's edge in the graph to change its length, and pick its zone from the rail beside it. The workout's total time, load and intensity update as you go. - **One workout, two places.** The builder and the inspector edit the same unsaved changes, so you can switch between them freely. ⌘Z undoes step changes in either window, and nothing is saved until you click Save. - **Build library workouts.** **New Workout** in the library opens the builder for a new workout: give it a name, choose a folder and save it straight to your intervals.icu library. **Edit** on a library workout opens it the same way. If a save fails, your changes stay in the window so you can try again.

## What's new in 0.3.0
- **Edit workouts as blocks.** A planned workout's steps now show one per line in the inspector. Tap a time to change it, or tap the zone to pick another from your own zones (with your watt, heart-rate or pace ranges) or type a percentage. The **···** menu duplicates, deletes or moves a step, or turns it into a repeat, and repeats have − / + to change the count. Switch to **Text** at any time to edit the step text directly. Adding a workout works the same way. - **See the shape as you edit.** The workout graph redraws as you change steps and highlights the one you are editing. Lines Icuity can't read are kept exactly as written and flagged. - **Undo step changes** with ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z, or the undo and redo buttons. - **A tidier inspector.** The date, sport and indoor setting sit as small buttons under the title, so the steps start near the top without scrolling. - **Edit notes and other events.** Notes, holidays and other calendar events can now be renamed, given new dates (including a multi-day span) and described, right in the inspector.

## What's new in 0.2.3
- **Try Icuity without an account.** Choose **Try demo** when you first open the app to explore with sample workouts. An optional four-step walkthrough shows how to select, move, edit and schedule workouts. Nothing in the demo touches your calendar, and connecting your account clears it. - **Rename workouts in place.** Click a planned workout's title in the inspector to edit it. Return saves; Escape discards. - **Library layout fix.** The Library no longer slides under the title bar, including in narrow windows.

## What's new in 0.2.2
- **A clearer installer.** Opening the download now shows a simple window: drag Icuity onto Applications to install. It also says what to do if macOS blocks the first launch. - Nothing changes inside the app; if you already have Icuity installed, this update is optional.

## What's new in 0.2.1
- **Choose when your week starts.** Weeks now start on Monday. To change that, open **Settings ▸ Calendar** and pick Sunday, or Follow system to use your Mac's region setting. The week view, month grid, day picker, weekly totals and the menu bar's week all follow it.

## What's new in 0.2.0
- **In-app updates.** Icuity now checks for new versions and offers to install them. Use **Icuity ▸ Check for Updates…** any time, or turn on automatic installation in **Settings ▸ Updates**. An update waits until unsaved edits are saved. - **Your own zones.** Workout previews and targets use your intervals.icu settings for each sport: FTP, threshold heart rate, threshold pace and zones. - **Fixes.** Long calendar events keep their full length, the sidebar comes back when you widen the window, server errors are shown in plain language, and Undo Delete no longer lingers after you switch accounts.
This is the last version you need to install by hand. Later versions arrive through the app.
